data.name: ProjectDefinition_SingleRelativePathSegment
data.value: 该值必须是单个相对路径段。
data.comment: Diagnostic for a tool-project path value. A path segment is one relative name, not a path containing directory separators.

data.name: ToolExecutionProgress_MustBeFiniteBetweenZeroAndOne
data.value: 工具进度必须是 0 到 1 之间的有限值。
data.comment: Diagnostic for invalid tool-execution progress. The numeric value is a fraction in the inclusive range 0–1.
